name: grave-gateau-rest-and-sacrifice-puts-a-buff-counter-on-a-specter
notes: The generator filed this printed ACTIVATED ability in the play-time $cardActivatedAbilities table, so the field click was routed through ActivateCard (the item treated as a card being played): the effect ran but the printed REST / banish-self / sacrifice cost was never paid and the item could be re-used for free every time. Registered as a field activation ($activateAbilityAbilities in Custom/GameLogic.php; ActivatedAbilityCost pays the cost) and the play-time body neutralized in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php. The sacrifice is now paid as a cost rather than inside the effect body.

rulesClauses: [REST], Sacrifice CARDNAME: Put a buff counter on target Specter ally.

engineBug.summary: Grave Gateau's activation was misrouted (its sacrifice ran inside the play-time body).
